run_gpe_gpi_experiment: run GPE/GPI experiment evaluating a trained keyboard model on the scavenger environment with ground truth weights
run_episode_loop: run multiple evaluation episodes using experiment.run_episode and collect returns for each episode
load_keyboard_model: load a pre-trained keyboard model from a TensorFlow Hub path using SmartModuleImport
create_regressed_agent: create a regressed agent with fixed init weights and disabled training via zero learning rate
export_returns_to_csv: export episode return values to a CSV file using gfile and csv.writer
